say:2:1331030001:1.text: We grew up in the same town. What does that say to you?
say:2:1331030001:1.source_cn: 一个镇子一起长大的，你说呢？
say:2:1331030001:1.male: We grew up in the same town. What does that say to you?
say:2:1331030001:1.female: We grew up in the same town. What does that say to you?

say:3:1331030002:1.text: I don't get it—why won't he just admit he's Ganon?
say:3:1331030002:1.source_cn: 但我不理解，他为什么不愿意承认自己是加诺夫。
say:3:1331030002:1.male: I don't get it—why won't he just admit he's Ganon?
say:3:1331030002:1.female: I don't get it—why won't he just admit he's Ganon?

say:4:1331030003:1.text: That's enough, Pelan! I already told you I'm not Ganon!
say:4:1331030003:1.source_cn: 该死，皮陆斯！我都说了我不是加诺夫！
